description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Defense Logistics Agency simplified-acquisition RFQs from DIBBS, the bid board where DLA posts thousands of small-purchase solicitations (parts, medical, clothing, subsistence) that rarely appear on SAM.gov. Filter by keyword, NSN, solicitation number, or buyer code. Quotes are due 3:00 PM Eastern on the return-by date. Present as information only. One search counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.

QuotaBlock.description:
The caller's quota after this call: the binding window's limit,
remaining uses, and reset time. kind is 'pseudonymous' (subject hash or
shared IP bucket, never called 'anonymous') or 'signed-in' (free GovInbox sign-in).
quota_warning carries the 80%-used warning from check_and_charge when
the caller has crossed the threshold; absent otherwise.
